title: FirewOreks
body:
#### Have you ever wanted to fortune ores with rocketry?
#### **No?** Too bad!

FirewOreks adds in firework based ore fortuning. By gluing ore blocks to a firework with resin, you can launch them into the sky, ending with a bang and raining down riches.

This is done by crafting a firework with some resin and ores, which creates an Ore Launcher. Which, when launched, explodes after a short delay, raining down fortuned ores. The fortune level is calculated by 2 + resin used in the recipe.
![An example recipe for a basic Ore Launcher](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HVu8oGF9/images/d28164bf2c423dcd5ca9672a84e3a7cf990f6556.png)
Also, Ore Launchers work in dispensers too, meaning they can be fully automated!
